name: Cognitive Parallax Engine
text: When you would spend a command token from your strategy pool: You may exhaust this card to instead spend a command token from your reinforcements.

name: Overlord Matrix
text: When you activate a system or a system containing your units is activated: You may exhaust this card to treat 1 of your units as galvanized during this tactical action for each command token in your tactic pool.

name: Domestic Production Agreements
text: You may treat command tokens in systems that contain your ships as units with PRODUCTION 1.

name: Bilateral Nexus
text: When you resolve the primary ability of a strategy card: You may exhaust this card to resolve the secondary ability of that strategy card without spending a command token.

name: Inner Sanctum
text: Gain the Inner Sanctum planet card and its legendary planet ability card, and ready them. You cannot lose these cards, and this card cannot have an X or Y assimilator token placed on it.

name: Kleptocratic Politics
text: After an agenda is revealed: You may exhaust this card and predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, resolve the secondary ability of a strategy card without spending a command token. If that agenda is resolved with no effect, ready this card.

name: Segmented Structuring
text: At any time: You may exhaust this card and remove 1 of your ships from the game board. Place non-fighter ships of the same type in that unit's system with a combined cost equal to or less than that unit's cost.

name: Replicator II
text: This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards. This unit can only produce units of the same type as those in its system.

name: Surveyor's Lens
text: Once per action, at the end of a tactical action: You may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control in the active system. When you gain a relic fragment during exploration: You may remove 1 infantry from the explored planet to ready this card.

name: Trait Harmonizer
text: Increase your commodity value by 1 for each different planet trait among non-home planets you control.

name: Ultimate Evolution II
text: When you would research a technology: You may flip this card instead.

name: Ultimate Evolution III
text:
Cost 8, Combat 2(x3), Move 3, Capacity 9
SUSTAIN DAMAGE, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 4(x3)
When this unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE: Cancel an additional hit.

name: Warspawn Juggernaut II
text: When you would research a technology: You may flip this card instead.

name: Warspawn Juggernaut III
text:
Cost 2, Combat 6(x2), BOMBARDMENT 6(x2)
SUSTAIN DAMAGE
When this unit produces 1 or more hits: You may damage it to place up to that many infantry from your reinforcements with this unit.

name: Seal of Revelation
text:
This technology may be treated as either a biotic (green) or propulsion (blue) technology.

ACTION: Exhaust this card to shuffle up to 1 purged exploration card that does not place a token on the game board into its respective exploration deck. Then, explore a planet you control.

name: Sigil of Transmutation
text:
This technology may be treated as either a warfare (red) or cybernetic (yellow) technology.

When you move ships into a non-home system: You may exhaust this card to give that system SPACE CANNON 5 (x3) and PRODUCTION 3 as if it were a unit until the end of that tactical action.

name: Power Word: Fabricate
text: Gain the Fabricate Station planet card and its legendary planet ability card, and ready them. You cannot lose these cards.

name: Power Word: Miracle
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to gain 1 command token in your tactic pool, draw 1 action card, and place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

name: Power Word: Disintegrate
text: At the start of each round of combat involving your units: You may produce 1 hit against your opponent's units. Then, you may exhaust this card to destroy 1 unit participating in that combat.

name: Power Word: Plane Shift
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to perform a tactical action in a system that contains no planets without placing a command token. Ignore the effects of anomalies during this tactical action.

name: Biomechanical Nutrients
text: When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability: You may produce 1 ship with a cost less than the number of hits produced in a system that contains your ships. Reduce that unit's cost by 1 for each die that produced a result of 9 or 10.

name: Stingers II
text: Cost 1, Combat 8, Move 2, Capacity 1, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 6(x3), SPACE CANNON 6

name: Oblivion Cannon
text: At the end of a round of space combat: You may purge 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system. Produce and assign hits equal to half its cost (rounded up) against your opponent's units in that system.

name: Mirrored Memories
text: ACTION: Play 1 action card with a component action from the discard pile and exhaust this card. Purge that action card instead of discarding it.

name: Lazarus Pods
text:
When you exhaust an agent to resolve its ability: You may produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 of your ships.

When you purge a hero to resolve its ability: You may produce 2 units in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

name: Eternal Aegis
text: During the first round of combat: You may cancel a number of hits equal to the number of leader types you have unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged.

name: Specter Step
text: At the end of a tactical action: You may exhaust this card to move 1 of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that contains no other player's ships. This ship may transport units.

name: Rift-Touched Bastion
text: When you activate a system or a system containing your units is activated: You may exhaust this card to treat 1 system that contains the active player's units as a gravity rift until the end of this action.

name: Thanatocyte Lattice
text: Once per round of combat, when a unit is destroyed: You may assign 1 hit to an opponent's unit of the same type in that system.

name: Graveyard II
text: Once per action, if a unit in a system containing or adjacent to this unit is destroyed: Gain 1 commodity, and you may produce 1 unit of the same type in this system, if able. Up to 8 fighters in this unit's system do not count against capacity.

name: Thunderbird Protocol
text: At the start of space combat involving your units: Select 2 of your ground forces in that system. Those units participate in space combat as if they were ships, and you may treat them as galvanized until the end of the combat.

name: Enhanced Plating
text: Once per round of combat, when 1 of your units uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE during combat: Roll 1 die. If the result is equal to or greater than that unit's combat value, produce 1 hit against your opponent's units.

name: Reinforce
text: Once per action, after you win a combat: The active system gains PRODUCTION 3 until the end of the action.

name: Fuel Cell II
text: After you activate a system: Destroy any number of your fighters to apply +1 to the move value of 1 of your ships during this action for every 2 fighters you destroy. This unit may move without being transported. Fighters in excess of your ships' capacity count against your fleet pool.

name: Hotswapping
text: When you activate a system or a system containing your units is activated: You may treat 1 unit type you control as if you owned its corresponding unit upgrade technology until the end of that tactical action.

name: Xenolith Dormant
text:
**UNLEASH**: Return 2 green Fragmentum tokens from your faction sheet.
When you would draw an exploration card: You may exhaust this card to instead reveal cards from that exploration deck until you reveal a relic fragment. Resolve that relic fragment as if it were the drawn card, then shuffle the remaining revealed cards into that exploration deck.

name: Xenolith Unleashed
text: After you draw an exploration card: You may exhaust this card to reveal cards from that exploration deck until you reveal a relic fragment. Gain that relic fragment, then shuffle the remaining revealed cards into that exploration deck.

name: Stalactium II Dormant
text:
**UNLEASH**: Return 2 blue Fragmentum tokens from your faction sheet.
DEPLOY: Once per turn, at the end of your turn: You may purge 1 of your relic fragments to place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships. This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards.

name: Stalactium II Unleashed
text: DEPLOY: Once per turn, at the end of your turn: You may purge 1 of your relic fragments to place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships. This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards.

name: Synaptic Relays
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card and discard 1 action card to draw 1 action card and 1 random Hydromorphic card.

name: Cytoplasmic Transports II
text: Once per action, when you discard 1 or more action cards: You may either produce 1 carrier in a system containing your ships or move 1 carrier you control to your home system if it contains no other player's ships. That carrier may transport units.

name: Restructuring
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to remove up to 3 of your structures from the game board and place them on 1 or more planets you control.

name: Mutualism
text:
You may use the PRODUCTION, SPACE CANNON, or PLANETARY SHIELD abilities of structures with which your units are coexisting.
ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose 1 other player. That player may place 1 structure from their reinforcements into coexistence on a planet you control. If they do, they gain 1 command token.
notes: It wont show you as able to use space cannon, production it will calculate when it is usable.
